decision: Selected the centroid of Maricopa County Assessor parcel 314-10-777 (situs 10437 E ELLIOT RD MESA 85212; owner of record AMAZON DATA SERVICES INC; 42.9 acres), the parcel named by every City of Mesa permit at 10437 E Elliot Rd (including the 'Expedite - Data Center, Building A' application PMT26-15404) and by the county air-quality dust registration 'PHX 062' for 'Two data center buildings', as the campus locator.

selected_properties.spatial_reference: outSR=4326 (WGS84) as returned by the assessor's ArcGIS MapServer

computed.method: Single-ring polygon returned by the assessor service in WGS84; centroid computed in EPSG:32612 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 12N) and returned to WGS84; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid

identity_bridge: City of Mesa building-permit rows at 10437 E ELLIOT RD all carry parcel 31410777: 'Expedite - Data Center, Building A' (PMT26-15404, a 229,416 sq ft single-storey tilt-wall data center with chiller platforms; opened 2026-08-20, status 'Revisions Required' on 2026-10-27), 'DC Improvement Plans' (PMT26-08422, 'New data center civil site improvements', issued 2026-10-06), '**AT RISK GRADING** Elliot Road DC Improvement Plans' (PMT26-10534, issued 2026-07-23), fiber-vault applications for Buildings C and D (PMT26-13313, PMT26-13314) and a guard booth for Building E (PMT26-18947).
The City of Mesa inspection view geocodes 10437 E ELLIOT RD at (-111.608538, 33.349686), inside parcel 314-10-777, 317 m from the centroid.
The assessor gives the parcel the situs 10437 E ELLIOT RD MESA 85212 and the owner AMAZON DATA SERVICES INC (Seattle, WA), deed 20240695306 of 30 December 2024.

The Maricopa County Air Quality Department facility register lists F057451 'PHX 062' at 10437 E Elliot Rd, Mesa, parcel 314-10-777, a dust-control registration (facility type 'Greater than 10 acres', status 'Operating') described as 'Two data center buildings'; its register point lies inside the parcel, 323 m from the centroid.
not_used: No geocoder other than the city's own inspection geocode, no map viewport, map widget or city centre was used. The 'PHX066' designation used by earlier holds is an inference and is not adopted.
precision_note: The point is the centroid of the 42.8-acre Amazon parcel; the footprint of Building A and the other buildings within it are not published.
